symptom: ALTER ASSOCIATION (owner, storage, comment, delete behaviour) and CREATE OR MODIFY ASSOCIATION on a cross-module association print success and write nothing; DESCRIBE shows the old values (#792)
cause: UpdateDomainModel rebuilt Entities and Associations and left CrossAssociations as raw passthrough under a stale comment claiming they were not in the semantic model — crossAssocFromGen had been filling them on every read
fix: patchCrossAssociations: edit each stored CrossAssociation in place, setting only properties that differ (GUID, export level, capabilities never touched); restrict side gets its refusal text, leaving restrict rebuilds the delete behaviour under its $ID so the message slot is null; a stored one absent from the semantic model is refused. Executor reads the association back after ALTER and errors 'change not persisted' on mismatch
insight: A whole-model update that rebuilds some lists and passes others through is only as correct as its list of what the semantic model carries; when a read converter exists for a list, the write side must consume it. The executor's success message was never evidence — a read-back is. A cleared gen Part omits the key; to get Studio Pro's explicit null, rebuild the element so the registered NullFields apply
